data.description: German Payment Services Supervision Act transposing PSD2. Includes Strong Customer Authentication (SCA), open banking (AISP/PISP), and operational/security requirements for payment service providers.
data.notes: Enacted 17 July 2017, effective 13 January 2018. Supervised by BaFin. Transposes Directive (EU) 2015/2366 — see secid:regulation/europa.eu/psd2.

match_nodes.description: NIS2UmsuCG — Gesetz zur Umsetzung der NIS-2-Richtlinie und zur Regelung wesentlicher Grundzüge des Informationssicherheitsmanagements in der Bundesverwaltung (German NIS2 transposition)

data.official_name: Gesetz zur Umsetzung der NIS-2-Richtlinie und zur Regelung wesentlicher Grundzüge des Informationssicherheitsmanagements in der Bundesverwaltung
data.description: German transposition of the EU NIS2 Directive (EU) 2022/2555; Article 1 enacted the recast BSI-Gesetz (BSIG 2025).
data.notes: Status: In force (enacted 2 December 2025, BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 301, effective 6 December 2025; verified as of 2026-11-05). Transposes Directive (EU) 2022/2555 (see secid:regulation/europa.eu/nis2) and replaces the 2009 BSI-Gesetz with the 2025 BSIG (see secid:regulation/gesetze-im-internet.de/bsig).

data.description: German Federal Data Protection Act supplementing GDPR with German-specific provisions.

match_nodes.description: SGB V — Sozialgesetzbuch (Fünftes Buch) / Social Code Book V (statutory health insurance)

data.description: German Social Code Book V governing statutory health insurance (Gesetzliche Krankenversicherung).
data.notes: German statutory health-insurance code. §393 (in force 2024-07-01) governs cloud use in healthcare and mandates a BSI C5 attestation.

children.description: §393 SGB V — Cloud-Einsatz im Gesundheitswesen; statutory mandate for a BSI C5 attestation

data.official_name: § 393 SGB V — Cloud-Einsatz im Gesundheitswesen; Verordnungsermächtigung
data.description: Permits processing of health data via cloud services only where the provider holds a current BSI C5 attestation (C5-Typ1 until 2025-06-30, C5-Typ2 from 2025-07-01; a comparable or higher-security standard may substitute, as determined by the BMG together with the BSI). In force 2024-07-01.
data.notes: Statutory mandate for BSI C5 in the German healthcare / statutory-health-insurance sector — this is the law that *references* C5, whereas C5 itself is the control catalogue. Cross-reference: the mandated control catalogue is secid:control/bsi.bund.de/c5 (AI companion: secid:control/bsi.bund.de/ai-c4). This law→control link will be formalized in the Relationships layer (SPEC §6); documented here in notes for now.

match_nodes.description: BSIG — Gesetz über das Bundesamt für Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik und über die Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik von Einrichtungen (BSI Act 2025)

data.official_name: Gesetz über das Bundesamt für Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik und über die Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik von Einrichtungen (BSI-Gesetz — BSIG)
data.description: German federal statute establishing the mandate and powers of the Federal Office for Information Security (BSI), federal IT/cloud security standards authority, and cybersecurity risk-management, registration, and incident-reporting obligations (§§ 28–39) for essential and important entities and operators of critical facilities.
data.notes: Status: In force (enacted 2 December 2025 by Article 1 of NIS2UmsuCG, BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 301, effective 6 December 2025, replacing BSIG 2009; verified as of 2026-11-05). Cross-reference: technical control catalogues and attestation criteria issued by BSI under this mandate (IT-Grundschutz, C5, AIC4, A5, TR series) live under secid:control/bsi.bund.de (e.g. secid:control/bsi.bund.de/c5); historical citations to the repealed 2009 Act resolve at secid:regulation/gesetze-im-internet.de/bsig-2009.

match_nodes.description: BSIG 2009 — Gesetz über das Bundesamt für Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik (superseded 2009 BSI Act)

data.official_name: Gesetz über das Bundesamt für Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik (BSI-Gesetz — BSIG 2009)
data.description: Historical 2009 BSI Act (including §§ 8a/8b critical-infrastructure obligations added by IT-Sicherheitsgesetz 1.0 and 2.0), superseded on 6 December 2025 by the recast BSIG 2025 enacted via NIS2UmsuCG.
data.notes: Repealed and replaced on 6 December 2025 by the recast BSIG (BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 301) — use secid:regulation/gesetze-im-internet.de/bsig for the statute currently in force.

match_nodes.description: BSI-KritisV — Verordnung zur Bestimmung Kritischer Infrastrukturen nach dem BSI-Gesetz (BSI Critical Infrastructure Ordinance)

data.official_name: Verordnung zur Bestimmung Kritischer Infrastrukturen nach dem BSI-Gesetz (BSI-Kritisverordnung — BSI-KritisV)
data.description: Ordinance under the BSI Act defining sector thresholds and covered critical facilities across energy, water, food, IT/telecommunications, health, finance/insurance, transport, and municipal waste management.
data.notes: Status: In force (enacted 22 April 2016, BGBl. I S. 958; statutory authority transitioned to § 56(4) BSIG 2025; verified as of 2026-11-05). Administered by BSI (see secid:control/bsi.bund.de for BSI technical security standards).
